identity.name: Portofino Automatic
identity.one_liner: The 40mm Portofino Automatic — IWC's 1984 dress watch reissued in the modern size, the most-cited IWC entry-level dress watch.

narrative.story: The Portofino is the 1984 IWC dress watch designed by Kurt Klaus, an entry-level three-hand in a 1980s Italian village aesthetic. The IW357404 is the 2020 reissue in 40mm (the original was 36mm). The 35111 caliber is a Sellita-based automatic with a 42-hour reserve. The Portofino is the most-cited IWC dress watch and the watch a collector cites when they want an IWC that is unambiguously a dress watch — no pilot, no Portugieser, no Ingenieur.
